rubric_items.reason: API and component behaviour well covered; the PatientDetailPage wiring (CO-7, REQ-1 placement, hasAppointments) and the POST/PATCH responses that now carry visitSummary have no test.
Assertions check exact counts, keys, link href/text and dates; the REQ-6 test compares the summary to the list endpoint over two adjacent days, a weak check of S-2 AC1.
Covers 404, zero counts, past unclosed Scheduled, future Cancelled, local-midnight day, No-show-only patient; misses the start-just-after-now upcoming boundary of S-1 AC4.
Vitest/Supertest and jsdom/Testing Library in the right folders with ID-prefixed names; deviation: HMS-24 REQ-1 has no test although the strategy requires one per requirement.
No counts or coverage invented; defers numbers to the verifier and states coverage is skipped, matching checks.json (coverage step skip).
